caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular lantern with four glass panels set in a dark wooden frame. The wood has a textured appearance, with rounded, evenly spaced decorative elements running vertically along each corner of the lantern. Each corner of the top surface features a small, pointed finial. The top of the lantern is flat with a slightly raised edge and has a circular hole at its center for ventilation. A curved metal handle is attached at two opposite points on the top, arching upward. The lantern stands on four short, square legs extending from each corner of the base. The glass panels are clear with faint blue and white hues, allowing visibility through the lantern. The entire composition is rendered against a plain, light beige background, and the object is centered with no other items present.
title: Candle Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
